Broadleaf.description: Broadleaf, a whisper of shade underfoot, cloaks the stealthy with its verdant embrace. Its drooping leaves yield secrets to those who know where to look.

Needle.description: The Needle, a slender, thorny appendage that pierces the earth with silent determination, grants an extra measure of resilience. Its roots entwine with ancient pines, yielding bountiful pinecones when foraged, their scent hinting at survival's sweet reward.
